items.titleZh: 墨西哥城赛道冷却问题加剧，奥迪车队失误导致车手车辆安全隐患
items.summaryZh: 墨西哥城赛道本身冷却问题就存在，奥迪车队在弗雷迪·斯莱特的车上留下风扇，导致车辆处于不安全状态。
items.originalTitle: Cooling can be an issue enough as it is in Mexico City, but Audi making it even harder by leaving a fan stuck in the sidepod of Freddie Slater's car f...
items.summaryEn:
Cooling can be an issue enough as it is in Mexico City, but Audi making it even harder by leaving a fan stuck in the sidepod of Freddie Slater's car for a lap
Noted by race control as the car being in an unsafe condition #F1 #MexicoGP
detailZh:
冷却问题在墨西哥城就已经足够棘手了，但奥迪却让事情变得更糟，因为他们让弗雷迪·斯莱特的车侧翼子板上的风扇卡住了一圈
赛车控制部门注意到这辆赛车处于不安全状态 #F1 #墨西哥GP
detailEn:
Cooling can be an issue enough as it is in Mexico City, but Audi making it even harder by leaving a fan stuck in the sidepod of Freddie Slater's car for a lap
Noted by race control as the car being in an unsafe condition #F1 #MexicoGP
